regions.tonight: Dry tonight with long clear spells and patches of mist and fog forming in light northwesterly or variable breezes. Lowest temperatures of 1 to 5 degrees, with a touch of frost possible in places.
regions.tomorrow: Any mist and fog patches will clear on Saturday morning to leave a dry, bright and crisp day with plenty of sunshine. Highest temperatures of 11 to 13 degrees with light northeasterly or variable breezes.
